title: Summary: samples and the time axis

clips.caption: Three things to keep: a <emphasis level="strong">signal</emphasis> is a quantity that changes over time; a <emphasis level="strong">discrete signal</emphasis> is described by <emphasis level="strong">samples</emphasis> and the sample interval; stem suits discrete samples better than plot.

The next section generates real <emphasis level="strong">sine signals</emphasis> and watches how <emphasis level="strong">frequency</emphasis> and <emphasis level="strong">phase</emphasis> change the waveform.
